notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Zombies.
description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
